summary: This report provides information on the status of the Golden Mile Secondary Plan ("GMSP") Study (Alternatives Report) and recommends the expansion of the study area boundaries to include additional lands west of Victoria Park Avenue and along the southern boundary (south of Eglinton Avenue East). As a result of the recommended expansion, the Study Area would increase from 97 hectares (refer to Attachment 1) to 113 hectares (refer to Attachment 2). The purpose of this report is also to present the "Golden Mile Secondary Plan Study: Alternatives Report", which provides a summary of Phase Two of the Golden Mile Secondary Plan ("GMSP") Study. This phase was undertaken to further develop the vision and guiding principles for the study area. Several development alternatives were identified for the Golden Mile that were analyzed by the GMSP consultants, City staff and commenting agencies (refer to Attachment 3).
decided: City Council on April 16 and 17, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council extend the boundaries of the Golden Mile Secondary Plan Study in accordance with Attachment 2 to the report (March 8, 2019) from the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning. 2. City Council waive the requirements of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 27-16.2 and Chapter 27-16.5 and direct that all reports related to the Golden Mile Secondary Plan and the statutory hearing required under the Planning Act be directed to Scarborough Community Council rather than the Planning and Housing Committee and City Council request the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning to provide a report to the North York Community Council prior to the statutory hearing for further consideration, input and direction to the Chief Planner, Executive Director, City Planning for incorporation into the final report for the statutory hearing. 3. City Council request the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning to add business and resident representatives from the west side of Victoria Park to the working group in consultation with the Deputy Mayor. 4. City Council request the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning to hold a special meeting with residents of former East York and North York west of Victoria Park for the road reconfiguration.
